opcodes.name: SHOW_LEFT_PORTRAIT
opcodes.purpose: Renders character dialogue avatar in the left slot

opcodes.name: SHOW_RIGHT_PORTRAIT
opcodes.purpose: Renders character dialogue avatar in the right slot

opcodes.name: SPAWN_ACTOR
opcodes.purpose: Spawns a zombie or interactive entity at coordinates X, Y

opcodes.name: TRIGGER_LEVEL_VICTORY
opcodes.purpose: Transitions level to victory statistics screen (state 7)

opcodes.name: MODIFY_DOOR_COLLISION
opcodes.purpose: Opens or closes interactive doors and toggles solid tile state

opcodes.name: LOCK_PLAYER_CONTROLS
opcodes.purpose: Freezes main game loop inputs to start dialog/cutscene sequences

opcodes.name: UNLOCK_PLAYER_CONTROLS
opcodes.purpose: Unfreezes main game loop inputs to resume active play

opcodes.name: GIVE_STORY_ITEM
opcodes.purpose: Puts keycards or special quest items into player inventory slot

opcodes.name: SET_HUD_OBJECTIVE
opcodes.purpose: Changes active objective text rendered in bottom/top HUD overlay

opcodes.name: PLAY_AUDIO_BUFFER
opcodes.purpose: Loads and loops MIDI soundtrack or play sound effects
